problem: Source, preview and preset name dialogs could return after Workshop closed or was destroyed, changing fields or starting a new import.
change: Check Qt validity, visibility and owner lifetime before opening these modal dialogs and before consuming their results. Existing uploads continue after dialog closure.

reproduction.cases: source file, source folder, preview and preset name, each rejected or destroyed before modal return

coverage: Eight closed or destroyed dialog cases discard modal results and refuse subsequent modal entry.
Three picker cases preserve empty fields on cancel and populate the correct fields after reopening and retrying.
A real local preset package is not imported after closure or cancellation; reopening and retrying imports equivalent data and preserves cache readiness.
The existing simulated Steam event test retains upload completion after dialog closure.

limitations: Unit tests use offscreen Qt. Native checks use real Windows widgets on a private desktop with widget-local keyboard events and substituted modal results.
No real Steam publication or OS keyboard input was verified.
Full regression, independent review and integration remain pending.

keyboard_fix.problem: Native Tab navigation stopped at QPlainTextEdit because Tab inserted text.
keyboard_fix.red_result: 1 failed, 18 deselected in 2.11s; tags.hasFocus() was False after Tab.
keyboard_fix.verification: Tab moves to tags without changing description, Backtab returns, and Enter still inserts a newline.

native.platform: Windows private desktop, Traditional_Chinese, dark theme, 900x740 main window
native.entry: Actual MainUI.open_workshop entry, with widget-local Tab/Space on real buttons; modal results substituted.
